sites.name: bVaultX
sites.pitch: Lock it away for as long as you like, and get it back from your 12 words.
sites.title: bVaultX · The vault that pays for itself
sites.description: bVaultX: lock BSV for as long as you want your files kept, and the lock pays for storage month by month. Prepaid, time-locked, and yours: you keep the keys and can always get unspent BSV back from your 12 words.

status.text: Lock BSV. Time locks in bWalletX: all at once, or spread daily, weekly or monthly, up to about ten years. bWalletX › Lock
Claim when it opens. Matured locks come back to your wallet in one tap. bWalletX › Lock
Recover from your 12 words. Locks use your own keys, so a restored wallet still sees and claims them. No server needed.
Lock receipts you can check. An optional receipt in the same transaction, checked against the chain. bwalletx.com/lock/verify
Pots. Group your locks by what they're for, like a savings goal.
Prepaid storage vaults: lock BSV for your files on bDriveX, paid by monthly payments your wallet signs in advance, each time-locked to its month.
Stop any time. Stop, and we stop storing; payments for months that haven't come yet stay yours.
Keep a Space recording when everyone on stage agrees, stored at the host's cost.
Lock other coins in a vault: BTC and ETH, with the same rule that you hold the keys.

Writing saved on chain. Bitcoin Writer saves your documents to the BSV blockchain. Bitcoin Writer
Store any file in bDriveX and find it again from any device with your wallet.
Pay as long as you like: monthly payments your wallet signs in advance, each time-locked to its month. Stop paying and we stop storing.

sites.name: bSharesX
sites.pitch: Share-register software for any company. The first register is in testing.
sites.title: bSharesX · Share registers, kept the modern way
sites.description: bSharesX: software for keeping share registers, for any company. The register stays the legal record, a token mirrors it on chain, and each holder's certificate is a live view in their wallet.

status.text: First register in testing. The Bitcoin Corporation Ltd, our own company, keeps its register in bShares inside bWalletX. Restricted to its registered members and director. bWalletX › bShares (direct editions only)
Set up your company's register. Any company enters its members and holdings, and its directors approve them.
Holdings in bWalletX. Members see what they hold, in their own wallet, next to everything else.
Live certificates. A certificate that redraws when the register changes, plus an optional keepsake mint.
Record transfers. A transfer is entered when the directors approve it, and the on-chain record follows the register.
Member votes. Resolutions counted by holding, straight from the register.
Payouts. A company pays its members pro rata to their holdings, from its own wallet.
Partnership shares. For groups that haven't incorporated yet: a locked record of who holds what, that moves only when the partners agree.

sites.name: bWriterX
sites.pitch: Write it down. Keep it forever.
sites.title: bWriterX · Write it down. Keep it forever.
sites.description: bWriterX is Bitcoin Writer: a writing app that saves each version of your work to Bitcoin, encrypted and timestamped. On the web and on Mac today. Publishing and pay-to-read are coming.

status.text: A full writing app. Write and format documents in your browser, with tabs and autosave. bitcoin-writer.vercel.app
Bitcoin Writer for Mac, 1.5.0. Apple Silicon and Intel, with native menus and saving to and opening files on your Mac. Download from GitHub
Save to chain. Each save is written to Bitcoin as a new version, with a timestamp and a transaction you can look up. File › Save to Chain
Private by default. Your text is encrypted in the app before it is saved, with a key only your sign-in can open.
See the price first. You get a quote in sats before you pay, and you pay from your HandCash wallet.
Version history. A work tree of every save. Open any old version, or fork a document into two branches. History › Work Tree
Open from chain. Paste a save's transaction ID and the document opens again.
Sign in with bWalletX. Save and pay through any BRC-100 wallet, bWalletX first. Today the app signs in with HandCash.
Prove it or Inscribe. Put just a fingerprint of your text on chain to prove it existed, or the full text in the open, with bMintX.
Signed in your name. Each published piece carries your $name, so readers know who wrote it.
Pay to read. Free stays free. Paid pieces cost what it costs to serve them plus a small premium, and the money goes to the writer.
Articles in bChatX and bNews. Share a piece into a room or the news feed, with the paid part unlocked in one tap. bnewsx.com
Files on bDriveX. Keep drafts, images and attachments in your own storage. bdrivex.com
